_readme: Vehicles and liveries that /server-check flags. prohibitedVehicles are flagged for everyone. restrictedVehicles are flagged for everyone except Server Boosters. Vehicle names are matched loosely (case, spacing and small spelling differences are ignored, but the year must match). restrictedLiveries (exact name, case ignored) are flagged for everyone whose in-game team is NOT in liveryIgnoredTeams (civilian cars use the Standard livery too); no membership unlocks them. staffLiveries: any livery whose name CONTAINS one of these (case ignored) is flagged when the driver has no staff role. Run /setup reload after editing.
